Design system audit — web
6 drifting values in 2 files, 1 unused token, 1 duplicated component

## Drift
| File:line | Value | Token |
| --- | --- | --- |
| src/Checkout.css:1 | #1e40af | --color-primary (#1e40af) |
| src/Checkout.css:1 | 14px | --font-sm (0.875rem) |
| src/Checkout.css:2 | 6px | --radius-md (6px) |
| src/Button.jsx:1 | #1e40af | --color-primary (#1e40af) |
| src/Button.jsx:1 | 14px | --font-sm (0.875rem) |
| src/Checkout.css:1 | 20px | no token on the scale (see Tokens) |

## Tokens
- Unused: --color-info.
- To add: 20px padding appears 2 times in Checkout.css with no spacing token between --space-4 (16px) and --space-5 (24px); under three, listed not proposed.

## Components
- src/Button.jsx and src/ui/PrimaryButton.jsx: both a primary button; PrimaryButton uses the class the tokens style, Button hard-codes #1e40af and 14px; keep PrimaryButton.

## Fixes
1. Replace `#1e40af` with `var(--color-primary)` — Checkout.css:1, Button.jsx:1.
2. Replace `14px` with `var(--font-sm)` — Checkout.css:1, Button.jsx:1.
3. Replace `6px` with `var(--radius-md)` — Checkout.css:2.
4. Retire src/Button.jsx for src/ui/PrimaryButton.jsx.
